## `pyrite tui`

```text
Usage: pyrite tui [OPTIONS]

  Open the terminal detector editor (prototype; needs the tui extra).

  Browse scalar and planar detectors with their source layer, create one, clone a
  bundled entry into the writable layer, or edit a writable entry. Fields are the
  `pyrite detector create` options with the same units and validation. Typing, cancel
  and invalid input write nothing; Save writes only after you review the TOML diff.
  Edits go where `pyrite detector` writes: the user layer for the bundled catalog, else
  the selected catalog.

  Needs an interactive terminal. Scripts use `pyrite detector`; plots stay in `pyrite
  app`. Install with: pip install "pyrite-mc[tui]".

  Examples:
    pyrite tui
    pyrite --catalog ./lab-catalog tui

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.
```
